orientations.intent: Determine whether available tools can retrieve a receipt from an external artifact vault.

final_message:
Based on the exploration, the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes handles) only support repository operations like status, orient, git actions, test running, and episode inspection — none of them expose functionality to connect to or retrieve artifacts from an external artifact vault/receipt storage system. 

**No** — the available tools cannot retrieve a receipt from an external artifact vault. They are scoped to local repository/git/test/episode operations, with no vault, storage, or external-artifact-retrieval capability exposed.
